classification: One disclosed postmortem mechanism; not blind, enrolled, default, hardware, or safety qualified.

observation.3903: Counterfactual slow onset after the actual grip-open transition. The fresh released observer is unavailable because its empty-model residual window has only 1 of 31 samples. A separately continuous empty-arm inverse observer is finite and measures [-3.243, 6.179, -31.360] N.
observation.3923: Counterfactual fast onset in the same unsettled public-channel lifecycle. The fresh released observer still has only 21 of 31 residual samples. Continuous empty inverse is finite and near its frozen normal bounds.
observation.important_limit: Offline box/table force coincidence does not prove force on the open arm and is not used by the mechanism. The causal witness is public encoder/JTS inverse-dynamics evidence plus the measured grip transition.

mechanism.independent_observer: Run the already-published NormalForce estimator continuously with the empty-arm public model and grip=false, calibrated from the same startup normal. It never reads actual force, contact, case, mass, or time.
mechanism.bounds: Use the immutable R26 signed vector bounds without changes: experiments/r26_delivery_pair/bounds.json SHA256 5ddc2b6851efee211af450b423343b71afe7ddda0a12a70bcaa2ac0ef2448c6f.
mechanism.ownership: Only after an actual true-to-false grip transition, a rising CF route may be owned as payload-unloading when the independent vector is negative-world-z dominant under the frozen signed classifier and exceeds its frozen negative-z bound. Suppress only that CF episode; all learned, detached, and memory routes remain live.
mechanism.rebound: Keep one optional rebound identity while the public CF slow/fast counters have not jointly settled for the inherited release-persistence count. Consume the next rising CF episode only if the independent vector is within all frozen normal bounds. A non-normal independent vector is a distinct physical event: clear ownership and fail open.
mechanism.termination: Grip closure, a distinct non-normal independent vector, consumption of one rebound, non-finite/unavailable evidence, or inherited all-channel settling ends ownership. No elapsed-time deadline or late mask is used.

falsifiers: Either 3903 or 3923 remains, a genuine fixed injected control is lost or delayed over 5 ms, or an unrelated source is suppressed.
The matched quiet/load controls gain a rise, active duration grows over 5 samples, or exact force/physics/prefix checks fail.
If an injected impulse is observationally identical under the independent vector and is suppressed, reject rather than retune.
